description:
Version 1.0.1 of the public GitHub repository supporting “An APP 1.4 Ontology and Labelled Corpus for Assessing Australian Health Privacy Policies: A Blind Test of Rules and Learning”. This repository snapshot includes the unchanged original research archive plus citation metadata, integrity information and licensing documentation added after the initial release. The original archive deposit is separately preserved at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24147899.

LICENCE SCOPE: CC BY 4.0 applies only to the authors' original work and only to rights they are entitled to grant. Third-party policy texts, quotations and other third-party materials are excluded and retain their existing rights and licensing terms. Public availability does not grant additional rights in those materials.

The archive contains 568 research files after excluding macOS metadata. Scientific experiments have not been independently rerun. Research predictions do not establish legal compliance.
